{{Top|leg}}
A '''locker''' was a small confined room or holding cell. It had a heavy metal door to prevent the captive from escaping. Some of them came with a slit in the [[Steel/Legends|steel]] door so the captive could see out. These lockers tended to be very small (only several feet wide) and provided no room for a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] to sit. [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] locked [[Vana Sage]] in one while he went out to attack [[Trade Federation Superfreighter]]s.
